subject: [PATCH] sched_ext: Specialize the DSQ hashtable compare

reviews.author: Tejun Heo
reviews.summary: Applied the patch to sched_ext/for-7.4 and suggested that similar optimizations be applied to other functions using u64 keys, such as scx_tid_hash and scx_sched_hash.
reviews.raw_body:
Applied to sched_ext/for-7.4 with the dsq_cmpfn() signature joined onto one
line.

scx_tid_hash and scx_sched_hash have the same u64 key and also fall back to
rhashtable_compare(). scx_bpf_tid_to_task() sits on hot paths too. Do you
want to do the same for them as a follow-up?

Thanks.

--
tejun

reviews.author: Usama Arif
reviews.summary: Agreed to send follow-up patches for the suggested optimizations.

2026-09-21.patch_summary: The patch optimizes the DSQ hashtable compare by providing a custom comparison function, dsq_cmpfn(), which reduces the overhead of memcmp() and improves performance on Meta's fleet. The change is achieved by passing a const object, dsq_hash_params, to the __rhashtable_lookup() function, allowing the compiler to inline the comparison. This optimization has a significant impact on hot paths in the scheduler.
